title: Menu structure and search
html:
The main path of the HR process: Settings → Position → Recruitment → Offer → Hiring → Onboarding → Active employee → Termination → Reports.

In the menu on the left, under the HR module, you find the following main menu items:

  • Positions

  • Recruitment

  • Employees

  • Documents and records

  • Working time and scheduling

  • Leave management

  • Assets and handover

  • Settings (with submenus)

Almost every list view has a search and filter panel. Using the filters does not only make things easier to find: the reports and the dashboard use the same dimensions (department, manager, period).
